verdict.rationale: Claude Code's docs clearly show extensive delegation capability—planning, multi-file coding, git operations, multi-agent orchestration, scheduled/remote tasks (claude-code-docs-2,3,6,8,9,10)—matching the story well. However, community evidence reveals significant reliability caveats: some users report near-100% failure rates, self-verification failures like accidental replace_all corruption, and degraded output quality over time (claude-code-comm-16,17,19,20), tempering the 'full' delegation claim.
